excerpt_en: The spring of 1904 in the mountains of Sasun, told through the men and women who held them.
content_en: The spring of 1904 in the mountains of Sasun, told through the men and women who held them. For weeks, villagers and fedayi fighters held the high ground against overwhelming numbers, buying time for word to reach the outside world. The letters and testimonies gathered here trace the uprising day by day, from the first warnings to the final retreat into the peaks.
